title: pkg/api: document the createImage checkpoint query parameter
body:
Fixes: #29472

<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->
The POST `/libpod/containers/{name}/checkpoint` endpoint accepts a createImage query parameter (used by podman container checkpoint `--create-image`) but it was missing from the swagger docs. This adds it, with a description matching the CLI flag. 
*Docs-only change, no code/behavior change*
